children: Plutonian Acquisition II entered into a Business Combination Agreement to acquire NT1 in an all-stock transaction valued at $500 million. NT1 shareholders will receive 50,000,000 Purchaser Shares valued at $10.00 per share, followed by a merger of the SPAC into a Purchaser subsidiary, with SPAC shareholders receiving Purchaser securities on a one-for-one basis. Closing is subject to customary approvals, including HSR, Australian FIRB, NYSE listing conditions, and shareholder votes. A $500,000 breakup fee plus expenses applies for certain material breaches.
